purpose: Pinned evaluation rule for the NCAAF totals information-source tests (W2 line movement, W3 weather, W4 QB), the walk-forward level tracker (W1), the v6.1 composition, the 2026-11-14 retrospective replay and the lopsided pre-registration. Committed before any validation or holdout number exists. Every later output records rule_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii) of this whole file, which is line-ending independent.
operator_instruction: Better means better level, bias and error than v6. The closing line stays the benchmark and is expected to win. The tracker enters v6.1 by operator instruction regardless of its validation delta.

frozen_inputs.note: Untracked frozen copies of four untracked inputs. Every script reads only the copies and refuses on a sha256 mismatch. The origin files may keep changing (a sibling session owns them); the copies are the evidence.

frozen_models.v6_total_calibrated_as: total_calibration.intercept + total_calibration.slope * raw_total, raw_total = grid[key][1], no floor
frozen_models.assertion: assert_v6_frozen() compares the stored and the recomputed params hash to v6_params_sha256 (not verify-frozen, which may fail on an LF checkout).

windows.basis: the `date` field of each cfb_v6_base_rows row (kickoff date as stored)

holdout.note: already looked at in earlier v6 checks; any read here is a one-time look

post_holdout.note: never scored in any window statistic; used only by the 2026-11-14 replay

windows.burn_in: rows with season <= burn_in_season (2016) in the frozen fit are excluded; the base-row file starts in 2017
windows.cohort: lined games: forfeits (history_snapshot is_forfeit) dropped; v6 must have a grid projection at the selected key; a total market row needs a selected total_line, a spread market row needs a selected home_spread_line (ESPN espn-lines-rule-1 `selected` block); rows with a no_call have no grid and are dropped
windows.v5_cohort: the common cohort for v5 comparisons is lined rows that also have a v5 base row

bootstrap.generator: a fresh numpy default_rng(seed) per call, never a shared stream, so a CI does not depend on call order across scripts
bootstrap.ci: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 (two-sided 95 percent); one-sided bound = 5th percentile
bootstrap.fixed_coefficients: select-window OLS coefficients are fit once and stay fixed while validation (or holdout) dates are resampled

primary.statistic: dMSE = MSE(baseline) - MSE(with_source) on validation rows (positive = the source helps)

totals.baseline: OLS of y on [1, close] fit on the select rows of that source's cohort
totals.with_source: OLS of y on [1, close, pinned features] fit on the same select rows

spreads.y: home margin (home score minus away score)
spreads.with_source: OLS of y on [1, close, pinned features]

primary.source_cohort: rows of the market's lined cohort in which every pinned feature (and the pinned close column) is non-missing
primary.pass_rule: validation 95 percent CI lower bound > 0 AND the one-time holdout point estimate of dMSE > 0
primary.exploratory: everything else (MAE, correlation, subgroup, per-season, any other feature) is labelled exploratory and never decides a verdict
primary.forecast_retest: fit on the select rows with the observed features, evaluate on validation/holdout rows by substituting the forecast columns (eval_features); the baseline and its coefficients are unchanged

W2.name: ESPN open-to-close line movement
W2.tier_reason: ESPN open and close blocks carry no observed_at; the movement is only known at close, so a pass is an upper bound
W2.open_definition: per event: median over eligible non-live providers (eligibility as espn-lines-rule-1 select_lines, i.e. not is_live) of the provider's open value: total_open, falling back to initial_over_under; home_ps_open, falling back to initial_spread (taken as stored, home-signed, never conditioned on the closing favourite). Each value passes the espn-lines plausibility bounds (|spread| <= 70, total in [15, 120]). The 'Opening' provider (provider_id 23, 2016-2017) contributes its own current line as an open value and is excluded from the close median.
W2.close_definition: per event: median over the same eligible providers of provider_values (the espn-lines-rule-1 per-provider value), excluding provider_id 23
W2.season_exclusions: Caesars-family providers (provider_name casefolded starts with 'caesar') are excluded from both open and close in seasons 2017 and 2018 (in-play contamination); the movement cohort's close is the median of the remaining eligible providers
W2.orientation_audit: report, never resolve: the count of provider rows whose initial_spread sign disagrees with fav_side

totals.formula: move_total = close total - open total (movement cohort values)

spreads.formula: move_spread = close home line - open home line; mv_close_margin = -(movement-cohort close home line)

intraday_2026.rule: from the runtime root's odds/ncaaf/<date>/polymarket_snapshots.jsonl and market_quotes.db (read-only): the main-line rung is the ladder rung whose over (or home-side) midpoint is nearest 50 percent at each observed_at_utc; movement = last pre-kickoff main rung minus first observed main rung; compared with actual minus the ESPN close; no select/validation data exists, so no verdict beyond DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY

W3.name: Open-Meteo weather bound
W3.tier_reason: archive weather is the observed outcome, which the closing line already prices from the forecast; a pass is an upper bound
W3.exclusions: dome home teams (resolve_team(...).is_dome) and neutral-site games; FBS home teams with latitude and longitude only
W3.game_window: hourly rows with timestamp in [floor_hour(kickoff UTC), floor_hour(kickoff UTC) + 3 h), i.e. three rows; hourly values are transformed first, then averaged

totals.formula: wind_mph = window mean of wind_speed_10m (mph); precip_in = window mean of precipitation (inch); cold_f = window mean of max(0, 40 - temperature_2m in F)

spreads.formula: wind_x_margin = wind_mph * close expected home margin / 10, close expected home margin = -home_spread_line

forecast_retest.tier_reason: Open-Meteo historical-forecast archive values are forecasts issued before the hour; a pass is PIT_PASS with a lead-time caveat
forecast_retest.run_only_if: the observed test passes the pass_rule on that market

W4.name: QB starter bound
W4.tier_reason: starters are derived post hoc from box-score pass attempts; the pregame availability is not observed
W4.starter_definition: starter = the team's passer with the most pass attempts in that game; qb_changed = starter differs from the team's previous game starter; backup_start = starter differs from the team's season-to-date attempts leader over prior games (the first game of a season is 0, counted)

totals.formula: backup_start_sum = backup_start_home + backup_start_away; qb_changed_sum = qb_changed_home + qb_changed_away (each 0, 1 or 2)

spreads.formula: home minus away of the same flags (-1, 0 or 1)

verdicts.provisional_note: a non-final run (no --final) never reads holdout rows and returns this value instead of a taxonomy verdict unless the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_DATA or DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, which do not depend on the holdout

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.flagged_definition: a flag feature (the source's `flags` list) is flagged on a row when its value is not 0; the count is taken on the select window and on the validation window separately, per flag feature; either window below 30 for any flag feature triggers it
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.n_definition: rows of the source cohort that carry every pinned feature, per window

verdicts.NOT_WORTH_BUILDING: the pass_rule fails; numbers are recorded
verdicts.UPPER_BOUND_PASS: the pass_rule passes for a tier 'leaky' feature (observed weather, post-hoc QB flags, untimestamped ESPN open/close movement); outcome = build a forward capture or a point-in-time retest; never enters v6.1
verdicts.PIT_PASS: the pass_rule passes for a tier 'pit' feature (observable before kickoff); may enter v6.1 under D-183-SHRINK
verdicts.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: tier 'descriptive': no select/validation data (2026 intraday snapshots)
verdicts.agents_rule: AGENTS.md: retrospective features that cannot prove they were observable before event start are rejected from the model

holdout_protocol.reads: each workstream computes its holdout numbers in exactly one `--final` run after its script is finished; the output records the script sha256 (line-ending normalised to LF) and holdout_reads = 1
holdout_protocol.rerun: a --final re-run after an edit increments holdout_reads (previous output's value + 1) and the report says so with both script hashes

tracker.feed: every non-forfeit row of the frozen cfb_v6_base_rows copy with a v6 grid projection at the frozen selected key (lined or not, FBS and FCS), including post-holdout rows as history
tracker.residual: r = actual total - frozen v6 calibrated total
tracker.result_buffer: a past game counts only if start_utc + 5 h <= T (inclusive; identical to v6 D-RES-BUFFER and scripts/cfb_v6_lib.py advance(): limit = cutoff - 5 h, bisect_right)
tracker.offset: mean of r over the window; no eligible game gives offset 0 and is flagged; a game window larger than the eligible count uses all eligible games

windows.day_window: eligible games with start >= T - N days (lower edge inclusive)
windows.day_window_fallback: a day window holding fewer than 50 eligible games falls back to the last 150 eligible games
windows.game_window: the last N eligible games in kickoff order, ties broken by event_id

tracker.selection: lowest RMSE of (v6 + offset) vs actual on select-window lined games (total line present); ties go to the earlier grid entry
tracker.line_tracker_diagnostic: the same tracker on (actual - close total); diagnostic only
tracker.entry: the tracker enters v6.1 by operator instruction regardless of its validation delta, which is reported with its CI

shrinkage.rule: a PIT_PASS component enters v6.1 as 0.5 x its select-window OLS coefficient (the with_source coefficient) times the select-mean-centred feature, added to the total (or margin) after the tracker

v61_composition.total: frozen v6 calibrated total + tracker offset (window chosen on the select window only) + sum of shrunk PIT_PASS total components
v61_composition.spread: v6 unchanged unless a spread source is PIT_PASS, then margin + the shrunk component
v61_composition.never: no leaky-tier component, no component that is not PIT_PASS, and nothing tuned after cfb_v61_spec.json is frozen

replay.label: RETROSPECTIVE REPLAY
replay.label_reason: 2026-11-14 is inside the data the lopsided tilt was found on; the tilt's real test is the pre-registered forward evaluation
replay.history: data/research/ncaaf_v6/history_snapshot.jsonl topped up from ESPN scoreboards (groups 80 and 81, completed games only), with the v6 extractor's 5 h result buffer; the tracker uses only games with start + 5 h <= kickoff, each projected by v6 at its own kickoff
replay.cohort_A: every completed 2026-11-14 game (event start in [2026-11-14T10:00Z, 2026-11-15T10:00Z), groups 80 and 81, FBS and FCS; v6 no-calls counted)
replay.cohort_B: the latest settled flat-tier cfb-structural-v5 total row per event in the runtime ledgers.db for that window
replay.closes: ESPN core odds fetched after every game is final into data/research/ncaaf_v6/espn_lines_20261114.jsonl using espn-lines-rule-1 (trim_item, select_lines)
replay.v61_probabilities: script-local subclass of CFBStructuralV6Model overriding only calibrate_means (calibrated total + offset; margin unchanged); seam check: a fresh v6.1 instance with offset 0 and a fresh v6 instance over the same rows in the same order give exactly equal probabilities on every cohort-B row

pnl.pick: each cohort-B row gets one flat 1U pick on the side with the larger model probability minus ask
pnl.ask: the ledger's market_probability for the ledger side and 1.0476 minus it for the other side (standard 4.76 percent vig)
pnl.edge_view: also the 2-8 percent edge view (v5 Main gate analogue)
pnl.v5_pnl: the ledger row's own result at 1U
pnl.units: percentages and units only, never American odds

replay.v5_projection: calibrated v5 total from the latest pre-kickoff ledger row's projected_total: max(24, intercept + slope x projected_total) with the v5 artifact's total_calibration
replay.report: cohorts A and B separately with n, and the lopsided / FBS-vs-FCS subset of each, for v5, v6, v6.1 and the line: MAE, bias, over lean, flat-1U PnL and ROI percent, W-L-P, the 2-8 percent edge view

metrics: over lean (share of model > close, ties excluded)
comparison.verdict: v6.1 beats the closing line only if the holdout paired MAE difference (v6.1 minus line) has its 95 percent CI entirely below 0

safety.http: read-only GET with a generic User-Agent, no project, person or repo identifier; no order or execute endpoint
safety.odds_format: percentages and probabilities only, never American odds

prereg_reference: outputs/ncaaf/cfb_lopsided_prereg.json (D-183-PREREG), written after this file and committed in the same step-0 commit
